verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance and case-management SaaS platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows REST APIs (Alerts, Case, Case import, filing) and an llms.txt help index, but nothing about an MCP server. Those are developer building blocks and adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
